caseNameFull: De Marcos v. Overholser, Superintendent of St. Elizabeths Hospital
attorneys: J. Ralph De Marcos, pro sc. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Mr. W. Marvin Smith for respondent.

opinions.text: *609The petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia; the motion for a supplemental record; and the motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, are denied.
